customer.name: WashKrew
customer.shortDescription: Book a doorstep exterior wash and review your Captain’s before-and-after photos.
customer.subtitle: Doorstep vehicle washes
customer.description: Book a doorstep exterior vehicle wash in an area covered by an approved WashKrew Captain. Add your vehicle and parking details, choose an available time window, and pay using the supported Razorpay methods or WashKrew wallet credit. Follow booking updates and review the before-and-after wash photos. Wallet credit can be used for future WashKrew bookings. Availability depends on Captain coverage, working hours and capacity.

captain.name: WashKrew Captain
captain.shortDescription: Manage your wash area, accept jobs and share before-and-after wash photos.
captain.subtitle: Manage your wash jobs
captain.description: WashKrew Captain helps approved Captains manage doorstep exterior vehicle washes. Submit your documents, selfie and payout details for human review. Set your service location, coverage radius and working hours. Once approved, go online to receive eligible nearby offers; the first valid acceptance receives the job. Follow the job steps, record before-and-after vehicle photos and keep the Customer updated. View job and earnings records in the app. Captain approval and available demand are required; this app does not guarantee jobs or income.
